template.name: WarriorTrading Momentum
template.entry_long: volume_ratio(volume,{p0}) > {p0} and close > open and (roc(close,{p1}) < {p1} or roc(open,{p2}) > 2)
template.notes: The three documented setups are collapsed into one: a volume spike (GapVolumeMultiplier=2 via volume_ratio) with either a red-to-green turn after MinRedCandles=3 down bars or a GapThreshold=2% opening jump; VWAP is approximated away in favour of the documented EMA/ATR pair. The ATR stop, RiskRewardRatio=2 target and TrailingStopTrigger=1 are ATR-scaled rather than fixed percentages, and MaxDailyTrades is unsupported, so both stop fields are null.
